fix_confirmations.run01_summary: Hard-reload of /fleet /timeline /questions /tasks /cost returned 401 instead of the SPA — API route beat SPA fallback.
fix_confirmations.run01_root_cause: readRoutes was mounted BEFORE spaRoutes, so a Bearer-gated JSON route intercepted the browser navigation.
fix_confirmations.fix_ref: 68d3ba5 apps/core/src/routes/spaNavigation.ts + mounted BEFORE readRoutes in serve.ts — accept-negotiation middleware short-circuits GET+HEAD navigation requests (Accept prefers text/html) on /fleet /timeline /questions /tasks /cost /overview /skills to index.html; SDK/XHR/curl calls (Accept: application/json) fall through to the Bearer-gated read route unchanged.

Same tabs with Accept: application/json → /fleet without Bearer still returns HTTP 401 'unauthorized' (auth intact); /fleet WITH Bearer → 200 JSON payload (API path unchanged).

In-browser hard-reloads: assets/18-hard-reload-questions-200.png, assets/19-hard-reload-fleet-200.png, assets/20-hard-reload-timeline-200.png — all three routes rendered the correct SPA screen after a cache-bypassing reload (H1 = 'Questions' / 'Fleet' / 'Timeline'; sessionStorage.gosleep.token still present).

new_findings.title: Status casing on client filter is strict: 'Open' does not match filter 'Open'; only lowercase 'open' does
new_findings.impact: If any producer writes 'Open' with a capital O (as the SQL schema allows — it is a plain text column), the row shows up on 'All' but NOT on 'Open' filter. Owner is unlikely to see it because DB rows in production are all lowercase, but there is no client-side normalization and no server-side enum enforcement.
new_findings.recommendation: Either lowercase-compare on the client (row.status.toLowerCase() === 'open') or normalize on write in the /internal/questions/post + /actions/questions/answer paths. Backlog-worthy, not a blocker.
new_findings.detection: Encountered while seeding hermetic test questions with 'Open' — filter returned 'No questions match'. Lowercasing to 'open' fixed it.
